title: CPU probe
author: hugz202 (AE-analog-rytm-mods); MKII port: Iced-Cream
description: A measuring mod: three labels of SETTINGS > MIDI CONFIG > CHANNELS show the processor's load instead of their names (the settings are untouched). PERF CHANNEL shows CPU, the time the processor was not idle; AUTO CHANNEL shows AUDIO, the audio interrupt's average share of the time; PROG CH IN CH shows PEAK, its largest share of a single block. Each covers the time since it was last drawn. Timed with DMA timer 0 at the audio interrupt's entry and exit (core's render events) and in an idle loop that replaces main()'s final spin. Port of AE-analog-rytm-mods 0011-cpu-probe (Analog Rytm MK1).
